yearly bases as indicted by Y1 in the title block.

once a year. When a tank is on fire, the foam system will protect the tank 
itself, and the water monitors will provide an adequate water cooling of the

sections.text: العمل الذي يتعين القيام به
Be sure that the oil tank is filled-up with mineral oil.

Be sure t/hat the electrical panel is correctly connected with 
 the power supply switching on the main switch (380/3/50 Hz).

The monitors must be tested in all their functions, 
 controlling the movements utilizing the hydraulic power pack.

Control the monitor movements in emergency condition operating directly on the 
 monitor hand wheels.

Control the opening / closure movements of the water interception valves 
 either through the hydraulic control or through the manual one.

Be sure that the water butterfly valves are easily movable by their emergency 
 hand wheels.

Operate alternatively the hand wheels (15)and control the horizontal and 
 vertical movements for both monitors.

Be sure that all piping connections and equipment's bolts are 
 correctly tightened.
Be sure that the oil tubing is correctly connected and fixed on its cable tray.

Be sure that all rotating joints, external shaft, and ball bearings are 
 suitably greased.

sections.text: Oil filling

Refill the oil storage tank with mineral oil, until the max. 
 level is reached.
Switch on the main pump.
Set up the relief valve at 50 bar (clockwise = increase).

Operate alternatively the oil distributors until obtaining a soft movement of 
 the unit driven.

During this operation the oil level decreases, due to piping filling thus, an 
 adequate quantity of oil should be added.

With the by-pass valve of the monitor in "MAN" position, the lines filling 
 operation should be easier.

In case of irregular movements of the monitor, due to air trapped on the lines 
 each higher tubing connection must be loosen allowing a free air vent until 
 arrival of pure oil.

When all the movements are correctly operated and the oil level is stable the 
 filling operation has been completed.
